subject: Penetration test report + remediation status / ETA for findings
messages:
From: BrightShield Sec <reports@brightshield.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>; Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Inference - Penetration Test Report (Aug 2026)

Hi Sofia / Redwood team,

Attached is the final penetration test report from our August engagement. We identified 18 findings across severity levels; the most material for production are:
- AUTH-04: JWT token replay risk in legacy session endpoint (medium)
- LOG-07: Insufficient logging retention for admin auth events (medium)
- NET-02: Internal load-balancer misconfiguration allowing backend access from restricted subnets (high)
- SECRET-01: Hard-coded service credential discovered in build artifacts (critical)

We've also attached a suggested remediation matrix that maps each finding to recommended fixes and verification steps (remediation_matrix_aug2026.xlsx). Please confirm receipt and let us know who on your side will own remediation and expected ETAs for the high/critical items.

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_aug2026_report.pdf (PDF, 3.2MB); remediation_matrix_aug2026.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

Thanks,
Jared Liu
Senior Consultant, BrightShield Sec
reports@brightshield.io

--
BrightShield Sec | https://brightshield.io

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: BrightShield Sec <reports@brightshield.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Penetration Test Report (Aug 2026)

Hi Jared — thanks for the report and the matrix. Confirming receipt. We will assign owners and provide ETAs for the high/critical findings by COB Monday.

Quick internal assignment plan:
- SECRET-01 (hard-coded credential): Dev Patel (Build/SRE) — remediation will include secret rotation, removing creds from repo, and introducing automated scans.
- NET-02 (LB misconfig): Karthik Iyer (Infra) — will verify LB rules and restrict subnet access; possible infra change window required.
- AUTH-04 (JWT replay): Mina Haddad (App Sec) — investigate session endpoint and add nonce/checks.
- LOG-07 (retention): Sofia Ivanova (Security Ops) — will update log retention policy and reconfigure retention in Splunk/ELK.

We'll return a populated remediation_matrix_aug2026.xlsx with owners, planned dates, and verification steps. Can you confirm the verification artifacts you expect (e.g., test accounts, logs, proof-of-rotation)?

Sofia
Staff Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

From: Jared Liu <reports@brightshield.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Penetration Test Report (Aug 2026)

Thanks, Sofia — the plan looks good. For verification we typically expect the following artifacts per finding type:
- SECRET-01: proof of credential rotation (rotated secret id), removal commit hash + CI scan results showing no secret, and access review showing no lingering principals.
- NET-02: updated LB config (terraform plan/apply diff), IP allowlist entries, and a short replay test showing blocked access from restricted subnets.
- AUTH-04: code change or config showing nonce/check implementation, unit/integration test results, and a brief exploit-proof test demonstrating the fix.
- LOG-07: updated retention policy entries, sample logs showing admin auth events for the new retention window, and a screenshot of SIEM settings.

We can take the validation after you've uploaded artifacts to the shared Drive link or sent a secure bundle (SFTP/PGP). We will aim to re-verify within 3 business days of receiving evidence for each high/critical finding.

Cheers,
Jared

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>; Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Penetration Test Report (Aug 2026)

Team — quick remediation ETAs after initial triage: 
- SECRET-01 (Dev Patel) — rotate credential and remove from build pipelines by 2026-08-05. CI secret-scan will be updated; will provide commit hash and CI scan output.
- NET-02 (Karthik Iyer) — LB rule change planned for 2026-08-06 (maintenance window 02:00-03:00 UTC). Will provide terraform diff and post-change access test.
- AUTH-04 (Mina Haddad) — mitigation (nonce + token binding) design doc by 2026-08-04, code PR by 2026-08-10. Initial mitigations (short-term rate-limit + stricter TTL) applied by 2026-08-04.
- LOG-07 (Sofia Ivanova) — retention increased to 365 days for admin auth events by 2026-08-07; evidence will include SIEM config screenshot and exported sample logs.

I will populate the remediation matrix and upload artifacts to the Drive link (see below) as items complete. If anyone needs to push dates, flag now.

Attachments referenced: remediation_matrix_aug2026.xlsx (I'll update and re-upload).

- Dev
Senior Build Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Liu <reports@brightshield.io>; Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, AuditOne <assess@auditone.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Penetration Test Report (Aug 2026)

Jared / BrightShield / AuditOne — quick follow-up and evidence timeline: 
1) SECRET-01: rotation complete by 2026-08-05. I'll upload a zip with the rotation proof (rotated_secret_id.txt), commit hash, and CI scan output to the Drive link.
2) NET-02: Karthik will post terraform plan/apply diff and a short packet-capture of blocked traffic within 24 hours of the change (target 2026-08-06).
3) AUTH-04: implementing short-term mitigations today (rate-limit + reduced TTL); full nonce/token binding work will be staged. Expect PRs for review on 2026-08-10.
4) LOG-07: Sofia to confirm SIEM retention change by EOD 2026-08-07; I'll collect sample logs and share a verification checklist for AuditOne.

Drive link for artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/Shared/Compliance/2026/pen-test/Remediation-Matrix-Aug2026 (will be populated over the next 7 days).

Mina Haddad
Application Security Lead
Redwood Inference
